title: Get Attributes All over unconnected messaging
purpose: Exercise the CIP common-service parser entry point for Get_Attributes_All inside a documented SendRRData CPF structure.
expected_behavior: The receiver should parse the 24-byte encapsulation header and CPF, dispatch CIP service 0x01 for the Class 0x04 Instance 0x01 path, and return a normal success or service-error response without an out-of-bounds read.
constraints_preserved: Encapsulation command is SendRRData 0x006f in little-endian form.
Encapsulation length is 25 bytes and matches the CPF payload.
CPF contains two items in Null Address then Unconnected Data order.
The CIP path size is two 16-bit words and matches the four path bytes.
Session handle 0x00000001 is an inferred assumption for an active registered session, not verified by the supplied sources.
issue_safety_notes: This seed uses a short ordinary path and includes no oversized padded EPath or empty request body associated with issue 577; it is intended as a non-crashing coverage baseline rather than a reproduction payload.
